type: manual native-client compatibility test (G-kompat), partial; descriptive, not a gate

setup.instance: local Docker Desktop C service (docker-compose.local.yml stremhu-source), image stremhu-source:sp-cand-69b899a (098838e switch + 69b899a harness), STREAM_KEEP_ALIVE=true via a test-only compose override; reached over HTTPS on the LAN name <HOST_IP>.local-ip.medicmobile.org:7070
setup.data: real indexers configured by the local bootstrap from .env (nCore, HunTorrent, Majomparádé); the user's own titles and accounts
setup.test_only_override: SESSION_SECRET set empty for this start (the .env value is below the current 32-character minimum, so the container would not start; the app generated and stored its own key)

clients.steps: a 4K and a Full HD title: play, seek, pause, resume
clients.perceived_speed: no difference the user could tell
no difference the user could tell

server_side.note: TCP connections to port 7070 seen inside the container (no addresses recorded); they include the web UI and the add-on's catalog and stream-list requests. No run with the switch off was made, so whether these clients reuse connections is not determined.
server_side.app_log: one asyncio-internal callback error at 21:13 (Broken pipe on client disconnect, no application frame; the known benign case from gsp02-v3); 0 tracebacks with an application frame

expectation_on_lan: the saving is about one round trip per reused request, a few milliseconds on a LAN (gsp09-v1: 14 -> 9 ms at 1 ms RTT), so no perceptible difference was expected

decision.text: Do not adopt keep-alive: the expected gain is small and uncertain (HTTP/2 clients gain nothing; a gain needs remote access and an HTTP/1.1 client that reuses connections), and upstream #274 may have closed connections for a reason that is not documented.
decision.consequence: SP09 closes without change: the switch is not merged into feature/stream-performance; the branch keeps the code, the gsp09-v1 evidence and this record.
